description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing webhooks, including creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting webhooks for authenticated users.

classes.name: WebhooksController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling webhook CRUD operations for authenticated users.

methods.name: createWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new webhook for the authenticated user.

methods.name: updateWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing webhook identified by webhookId.

methods.name: getWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific webhook by webhookId.

methods.name: getWebhooks
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks for the authenticated user.

methods.name: deleteWebhook
methods.description: Deletes a webhook identified by webhookId.
